## Goal
docs/user/troubleshooting.md: the 15 messages a user is most likely to see (find them in src/freemyid/ strings), each with what it means and one thing to do. Quote the message exactly; cite file:line in an HTML comment.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every factual statement about the product cites the source file:line it came from; nothing about features that are not on main.
- Plain words (target readers are older non-technical people for user docs; developers for dev docs).
- No real personal data; examples use Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL.
- Create no files outside the allowed paths (no scratch, backup or .new/.tmp copies).

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- docs/user/troubleshooting.md
- VENDOR_STATUS.md

## Out of scope / do not touch
src/, every existing file not listed above, every other lane in docs/BACKLOG.md.
